document: Universal Mobile Control — Audited Batch Chronology
source_rule: Current implementation facts come from the audited Universal Mobile Control source/config. Historical runtime claims remain historical unless freshly verified.

current_capabilities.typing: AccessibilityNodeInfo.ACTION_SET_TEXT on a focused editable node

chronology.result: AccessibilityService + local HTTP bridge + Termux MCP architecture established for screen reading and phone control.
Screenshot, accessibility UI tree and Latin/Devanagari OCR are combined for screen observation.
Health, screen, scan, Action Mode, tap, swipe, back and type endpoints exist; /home does not.
/screen is cached; /scan is asynchronous. A successful request does not itself prove that fresh OCR is already available.
Tap/swipe use AccessibilityService.dispatchGesture with GestureResultCallback, CountDownLatch and a dedicated callback HandlerThread.
Latest recorded tap and swipe tests returned callback timeout. Physical gesture completion and target-state change remain unverified.
Back uses GLOBAL_ACTION_BACK and was user-confirmed in an earlier test.
Historical README records successful native YouTube playback flow, but installed APK/service provenance was not established.
Action Mode refreshes every 3000 ms and can overlap manual scans; no single-flight scan guard is present.
Tap/swipe currently start Action Mode before dispatching the gesture, mixing action dispatch with verification work.
Gesture callback thread is stopped on destroy, but OCR executor and local bridge do not have equally explicit shutdown handling.
Previous chronology was rechecked. Unsupported PASS claims remain downgraded, historical evidence is separated from current proof, and fresh post-action verification remains mandatory.

audit_findings.finding: Tap/swipe are not currently proven reliable in the active runtime.
audit_findings.correction: Require callback result plus fresh post-action UI verification.

audit_findings.finding: HTTP 200 or dispatch acceptance is insufficient proof of action success.
audit_findings.correction: Treat JSON status/message and then fresh UI verification as authoritative.

audit_findings.finding: Installed AccessibilityService revision is not proven by APK file timestamp.
audit_findings.correction: Install exact APK, restart/re-enable the service and record build/hash provenance.

audit_findings.finding: Scan work can overlap between Action Mode and manual scans.
audit_findings.correction: Add a single-flight scan guard or serialized queue.

audit_findings.finding: Action verification is coupled to Action Mode startup before gesture dispatch.
audit_findings.correction: Dispatch action first; perform controlled verification scan afterward.

audit_findings.finding: ML Kit recognizers are recreated per scan.
audit_findings.correction: Reuse service-lifetime recognizers and close them on destruction.

audit_findings.finding: OCR executor and bridge lifecycle cleanup is incomplete.
audit_findings.correction: Explicitly shut down executor and close/interupt bridge resources in onDestroy.
Do not claim Home endpoint support until implemented and separately tested.

truth_table./type: IMPLEMENTED; current runtime effect not independently verified in this audit.
truth_table.HTTP_200: NOT proof of successful phone action.

verification_protocol.level_4: Fresh post-action scan proves the intended UI state.
verification_protocol.success_rule: Only level 4 is a fully verified action.

confirmed: Screen observation through screenshot, UI tree and OCR exists.
Gesture callback infrastructure exists in source.
not_currently_proven: Reliable tap completion in current runtime.
Reliable swipe completion in current runtime.
Current APK/service provenance for historical tests.
next_validation_gate: Promote to PASS only when the expected UI change is actually verified.
